notes.title: DAVY x JONES | EARLY ACCESS | POLISH & JAPANESE LANGUAGE ADDED!
notes.content:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/be0a555f99d6239aa1077e8a30c0220e154eacdf.png"][/img]

[b]🏴‍☠️ Ahoy, Landlubbers![/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]We've dropped another patch today, and alongside it you'll find something we've mentioned in our post couple of days ago. 

[b]Read more about the Early Access 2025 Roadmap here:[/b] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2611170/view/528732295326072912"][/dynamiclink]The whispers of our pirate's revenge are now echoing across new shores, and we're pumped to announce that [b]DAVY x JONES[/b] officially supports [b]POLISH and JAPANESE language - Interface & Subtitles[/b]! 
[/p][p]As a studio founded on the principle of crafting bold, story-driven games, we want to ensure our worlds can be experienced by as many players as possible. This update is a huge step in making The Locker accessible to a the next part of the crew and the people that'll join on our way to full release.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/29a47413a329e030bdbff9f6e05ca68c5a355698.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]⚓[b]New Languages available - POLISH & JAPANESE[/b]⚓[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/82472dfc64fd8a3995c64d980dd98c6b82ad6a6c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback is the compass guiding this ship, and we've heard your calls from across the globe. 
We're incredibly excited to welcome players from Poland and Japan to The Locker, a surreal pirate hell shattered into islands floating on an infinite sea of clouds with option to play in their native language. We've worked hard to localize the entire experience to the best shape, from the in-game menus to the tutorial text and every bit of cursed treasure you find.[/p][p][/p][p][b]This isn't just a simple update[/b]; it's a testament to our Early Access approach. We're dedicated to shaping this game with your feedback, [b]"island by island",[/b] and your input on language support was clear and direct. 

This is another step on our voyage, proving that with your help, we're building a legend, one update at a time. The path to revenge is a long one, and we want as many of you as possible to join us on this wild, dark, and full of dark humor revenge-driven ride.[/p][p][/p][p][b]So, if you've been waiting to dive into the seafarers' afterlife, or if you have a friend who's been holding out, now is the time to jump in!
[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]
We're incredibly excited for what's to come and can't wait to share it with all of you. Your support is what makes this wild journey possible. Let us know what you think and what you'd like to see in the comments!

Think you've got a killer idea for an execution? Found a bug that’s more twisted than a Kraken's tentacles? Or maybe you just want to shout about that epic moment where you sent some fiends packing? [b]We're all ears, you mad lads and lasses![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/af7d22484caf9bf8384674bf5a7b097621a071d2.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b][/p][p align="start"][url="https://discord.gg/gbG4sGCnQ6" style="button" buttoncolor="#5201e9"]Join our Discord! [/url][b]
[/b][/p][p align="start"]Don't just stand there, rotting in The Locker! Our [b]Discord [/b]is the ultimate pirate hangout, where we're constantly lurking, listening, and ready to lend a hand. We're reading your thoughts, watching your clips, and we're even taking notes on your ideas. Found a bug that's driving you nuts? [b]We're on it.[/b] Need a little help on your quest for revenge? [b]We're here for you.[/b]

Until next Time,

[b]PARASIGHT TEAM[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DAVY x JONES EARLY ACCESS | FAQ
notes.content:
[h1][b]Ahoy, Landlubbers![/b]
[/h1][h3]Think you can just waltz into The Locker and face down a pirate hell without a little help? Think again, matey. But don't you worry your headless body, your ever-so-helpful skull—and your friendly neighborhood Development Team — have put together a FAQ to get you started on your epic journey of revenge. [/h3][p][/p][h2][b]Let's make some legend. Shall we? [/b] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/3f20f6bb90f57423a7b0f41dcb801c4ba127ae3c.jpg"][/img][/h2][p][/p][h2][b]How Can I use other skills? How to buy them?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The first skill you can learn is [b]ROAR[/b] - R - use on groups of enemies or at close combat situations. It’s also the best way to increase your early damage output. Don’t save jewels for later skills as the game allows you to obtain enough of them later.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/14847f9703dfcc98e2689d173cb28cf445de4761.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]Is there any other way to not get hit, other than parry?[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Yes, that is - it's DASH[/b] - Shift - at just the right moment should keep you from harm and dodge enemy attacks, provided your timing is on point. It’s also the best way to enhance your traversal. Later you can mix it with a double-jump skill to dash mid-air.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]How can i prevent the fall damage - I'm dying every time I try to jump off from ledge.  [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Use [b]STOMP[/b] - Ctrl - when jumping down from a high ground or initiating fights with groups of enemies. By using Stomp you avoid taking fall damage and also it’s badass to land in the middle of enemies like they’re nothing. It deals slight damage and knocks back enemies.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/4a8e98779fdb806cb06e147a2322b62f6031e4fd.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]How can I fight those elite Pirates easily? [/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]Use [b]SHOCKWAVE[/b] - Hold LMB or [b]CANNONBALL[/b] - Hold RMB - to stagger enemies in front of you. Both keep you at a safe distance while dealing area damage. Once an enemy is staggered use your HOOK.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/54a45367c174565a4af0e2b128555c9e779dcc21.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Is the Hook only for traversal? [/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]HOOK[/b] - E - use once the enemy is staggered to get instantaneously in front of them and make some cuts. It’s also the best way to travel fast, get distance during a fight or get out from danger with moonlinks.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/41c8127f15b0d8ed4f761f5f9601904fe100f84a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]How can I heal myself during the battle - I die a lot because of lack of health. [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In most encounters there is [b]LIFE ESSENCE[/b] scattered around. Some are growing on the essence plants or moving around in air as essence flies. Enemies also drop them after using EXECUTIONS. Be warned, if you won’t consume them there’s a chance for them to merge into FUSION CHEST. Use Davy Action on them - E - while your HP starts dropping to save yourself from dying… AGAIN.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/708f71658e5244d817579bbbe0c522ec889f6cfb.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]What are those shark-chest things? [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Once you land a finishing blow on an enemy, they will spawn a life essence. If those essences are close enough there’s a chance they will merge into a [b]FUSION CHEST[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/0de6f9e989d55f1e71d531760ffe5c6c6542c1c0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Those chests are not a threat itself and you can still dig up treasure chests buried around. 
Yet, If you decide to open a FUSION CHEST and attack, prepare for battle!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/207eae1b1f94e0a80667f11588c4b398e909af6e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Sometimes I see a blue marker on the enemies - what is that? [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Once you land some hits on the enemy you will see a blue marker on them informing that they’re ready to be executed. Use [b]EXECUTION[/b] - F - to seal their fate. Executions are fast and effective, when dealing with many enemies or bosses go for the weak ones first - executing them allows you to heal and stay alive longer.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/98614f8796f1fb27811f21f97c77eb25b2b4355c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]Can I move from Island to Island freely? [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Go to the command room on your ship and use the table to travel the Locker. Browse your collection of ships in the bottle.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/b447c4e2ef12ce8e4749cc05c0b804502e2f9443.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]Where can I check if I explored the entirety of the Island? 
 [/b][/h2][p]Use the [b]Map[/b] - M and [b]Compass[/b], switch between the main quest and side quests in your [b]Journal[/b] - J. Explore deadly Crypts, Singroves and other points of interest to get the full experience of the pirate's underworld.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/f51d9c68b04cb8cf8bd9f5b6cb83064d712a5533.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]What is Singrove, and how can I use the Stars I've collected on an Island?[/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]Collect 6 stars from ghosts at guillotines spread across the islands of Limbo and Crossbones. Once you have 6 of them travel to the closest Singrove and put them in the coffin. Each island’s completed collection will increase your HP by 25 points.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/97d6d28d522d1647fbbc4b081bc13186e454fbf4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2][b]How can I Save the Game? [/b][/h2][p][/p][p]There is an auto-save system to keep your progress in crucial moments. Once you get close to the altar a save icon - the [b]FLIPPING COIN[/b] will appear in the left down part of your screen.[/p][p]

notes.title: Captain's Log #2: About The Locker
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy there! Dead, are we?☠️[/h1][p]
[i]Ever wondered what happens to a pirate after their last breath? Well, wonder no more, because today we're pulling back the curtain on the chilling, chaotic, and utterly captivating underworld that awaits you in DAVY x JONES.[/i]
[/p][p]DAVY x JONES is set in [b]The Locker[/b], a surreal pirate underworld shattered into islands floating on an infinite sea of clouds. Each of [b]the nine islands[/b] is handcrafted around a specific sin, from gluttony to treason, with scenery and torment to match.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/df88d7c7616cec776d16dcadb0b54d625e237958.png"][/img][/p][p]The Locker is home to twisted fiends, cursed souls, skittish boats, and overly dramatic barrels. Even the treasure chests here have deadly self-preservation instincts. And our biggest (literally) attraction? Legendary [b]Behemoths[/b] - like the mythical [b]Kraken[/b]. Born of flesh and shipwrecks, these creatures are said to [b]guard the underworld’s darkest secrets[/b]… and travel between realms. Don’t even think about sailing one. And don’t say you weren’t warned if you get killed... again.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/c08177cedae54050ecf8b0a982b5a80345197a55.png"][/img][/p][p]Every part of the Locker is infused with [b]Life Essence[/b] - a primordial force that [b]forms the fundamental building block of the miracle we call LIFE.[/b] It fuses into everything, from buzzing essence-flies to cursed fiends. [/p][p]If you spent your life chasing tides and treasures, this is where you wash up. And the ones who stay here? [b]Let’s say the Locker doesn’t keep saints.
[/b][/p][p]It was once a [b]purgatory[/b], a place for seafarers to reckon with their sins and find some peace. But ages ago, some of its native guardians - [b]the Tritons[/b] - claimed the realm for themselves and formed[b] the Legion[/b]. Redemption was overthrown. Peace? Discarded. Visionaries, in their own way. After all, why let sorrow and suffering go to waste when it can be harvested?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/2d9713400e36d538fc06d97947f3cd4e41049306.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Legion now preys on souls[/b] that drift here in search of redemption, draining their Life Essence to fuel some dark purposes. Whatever it is, best keep clear... unless you’ve got the fire to face down the Underworld.
[/p][p][b]Welcome to the Locker. You’ve been expected.🏴‍☠️

[/b][i]That's just a taste of the abyss that awaits. Will you brave the twisted islands and face the monstrosities within? Will you reclaim what was stolen and settle the score? Because in DAVY x JONES, your revenge journey through this surreal pirate underworld is just beginning.[/i][b]

Don't Forget to Wishlist![/b]   If you like what you see - please do us a favor and add [b]DAVY x JONES[/b] to your Steam Wishlist![b]

notes.title: Captain's Log #1: Unleashing DAVY x JONES – One Body, One Head, One Legend.
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy, future legends![/h1]

Welcome to our very first [b]"Captain's Log" [/b] on Steam! We're [b]PARASIGHT[/b], the studio behind critically acclaimed BLACKTAIL, and we are beyond thrilled to officially announce our latest title: [b]DAVY x JONES![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/596c5660e56bd341f43a627c2b3e24a09bf3c217.jpg[/img]

Prepare to descend into The Locker—a surreal pirate underworld shattered into islands floating on an infinite sea of clouds.

[h2]Meet the Crew... or Rather, the Protagonist(s)![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/5e47f71a3ccdc5cb6abbedb8d459e27c04cc8c47.png[/img]

At the heart of [b]DAVY x JONES[/b] is a fresh take on a pirate legend. You will play the role of none other than the infamous Davy Jones himself. Here's the twist: he's been betrayed, robbed, and ultimately – beheaded. But death is merely the beginning of his epic tale of revenge.

[h2]ONE BODY. ONE HEAD. ONE LEGEND:[/h2]

Control the captain's powerful, headless body— Jones.
Forge an unlikely alliance with your stubborn skull — Davy — as you reclaim your legendary Artifacts and face your eternal nemesis: Blackbeard.

It's a bizarre, unforgettable alliance where two halves of a legend fight side by side! This dynamic duo is central to the intense sword, gun, and grappling hook combat you'll master as you carve your path back into legend.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2611170/e2cfd01c72168767bbe86687cf0e429af089426b/ss_e2cfd01c72168767bbe86687cf0e429af089426b.1920x1080.jpg?t=1748276254[/img]
Journey through The Locker, facing twisted fiends, cursed souls, and legendary behemoths like the Kraken—guardians of the underworld’s darkest secrets. You'll also meet Abby: a young behemoth, hybrid of ship and whale who joins you on your epic journey as your base, your artillery, and your ally!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634753/44b6d875de4c1150ac41f2c7eecf9f50eb6cdc72.jpg[/img]

"[i]We're beyond excited to finally unleash DAVY x JONES upon the world,[/i]" says [b]Bartosz Kaproń, CEO and Creative Director of PARASIGHT.[/b] “[i]At PARASIGHT, we believe great stories should hit as hard as the action—and in [b]DAVY x JONES[/b], they literally do. We split our protagonist in two—his skull and his body—and threw them into the pirate underworld to fight their way back to legend. It’s our wildest journey yet, packed with surreal adventure, larger-than-life characters, and just enough surprise to keep things fun. If you've ever dreamed of swashbuckling through the afterlife with your own severed head cracking wise beside you—this is your game.[/i]”

💀 [b]Join our official Discord server to connect with the community: [/b] https://bit.ly/DAVYxJONES_Discord

Grow into power and unlock your true nature — because the only way out of Davy Jones’ Locker… is to BECOME THE DEVIL HIMSELF!

Stay tuned for more Captain's Logs, delving deeper into the world, mechanics, and story of DAVY x JONES!

Fair winds and following seas,
